title: Liquid merge tags in workflow emails must never contain double quotes; use dot access or single-quoted brackets
answers: workflow email link href breaks after inserting a person property merge tag
Liquid error expected "|" before filter in email template
merge tag renders blank / empty value in sent email
how should person property merge tags be quoted
body:
Symptom: a person property inserted from the email editor's merge-tag menu breaks a link (`href` cut short, Liquid parse error `expected "|" before filter`) or silently sends an empty value.
Root cause: the menu built `{{person.properties["name"]}}` in frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx; a double quote ends a double-quoted HTML attribute, and when it reaches the renderer entity-encoded (`"`) the decoder in nodejs/src/cdp/utils/liquid.ts does not decode it, so the tag resolves to ''.
Fix pattern: generate tags through `buildPersonPropertyMergeValue`: dot access for names matching `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/`, otherwise `['...']` with backslashes and `'` escaped. This matches `buildDelayExpression` in products/workflows stepDelayLogic.
Constraints: applies to any code that emits Liquid/merge-tag strings that may end up in HTML attributes. The liquid.ts decoder gap (`"`, `%22`) is still open, so do not count on the renderer to decode double quotes. Tests in emailTemplaterLogic.test.ts cover `$`-prefixed, spaced, dotted and apostrophe names.
applies: Email templater merge tags and any other generated Liquid expressions for messaging/workflows
